feeds.title: The Bioneer » Functional Fitness
feeds.description: Hello there and welcome to The Bioneer! This site and the accompanying YouTube channel are my passion projects. Here, I talk about human performance, psychology, fitness, health, self-development, productivity, and technology. I'm just fascinated with pushing the limits of human abilities. The functional Fitness section of the site collects articles relating to functional training. Build strength, mobility, endurance, agility, and more.

feeds.title: Redefining Strength Blog » Functional Fitness
feeds.description: My name is Cori Lefkowith and I'm more than just a bunch of certifications. My knowledge is from real-world experience, dealing with real people just like you! My goal is to meet you where you're at on your fitness journey regardless of your age or ability! Functional Fitness blogs can give you tips and tricks to gain body weight, for your muscles, and exercise routines.

feeds.title: 6262 Fitness
feeds.description: At 6262 Fitness, all programs (online and offline) are scientifically designed to help you improve your daily functionality. Besides, they will help you in building your overall strength, stamina, and endurance as well. Our fitness programs not only focus on your physical form but also on your immunity and nutrition.

feeds.title: International Functional Fitness Federation News
feeds.description: The International Functional Fitness Federation (iF3) is the nonprofit independent international governing body for functional fitness as a competitive sport. We provide international leadership, structure, and resources to fuel the growth of functional fitness as well as enrich the experience and safety of its worldwide participants.

feeds.title: Functional Training Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Functional Training Institute (FTI) is a movement-based education company focusing on Functional training and Movement restoration-based training methodologies FTI have worked with some of the best movement specialists globally, acquiring cutting-edge movement education that fuses practically derived knowledge with an evidence-based approach.

feeds.title: CR Functional Fitness Blog
feeds.description: CR Functional Fitness is the go-to blog for understanding how to stay fit and active as an older adult. Developing our functional fitness helps us move better, easier and free of pain through the activities we enjoy so that we can keep doing them. CR Functional Fitness is the only studio in the North Bay exclusively for older adults.

feeds.title: Aktiv Blog
feeds.description: At Aktiv, we amplify functional training spaces for health clubs, boutique studios, and fitness amenities alike. Our mission is to design safe, and supremely functional spaces supporting our client's delivery of inspirational exercise experiences. Find the latest Fitness Industry Trends, Insights & Showcases from the Aktiv Team.

feeds.title: Bay Functional Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Bay Functional Fitness (BFF) is an Oakland-based training studio for 1:1 and small groups. You'll find a non-intimidating environment with expert trainers and a fun, warm community. Our focus is functional training, emphasizing movements that have real-world applications to help improve strength, stamina, flexibility, and balance.

feeds.title: Tine's Functional Fitness Blog
feeds.description: I fix chronic pain, tightness, and injuries for runners, hikers, and climbers by retraining their bodies at a higher level and helping women return to running, hiking, and climbing postpartum. It is my mission to put you on the best path to reach your goals.

feeds.title: Functional Fitness Blog
feeds.description: The Functional Fitness (F2) studio in Portishead provides a unique boutique-style training environment that offers personal training and small fitness classes. It is designed, staffed, and equipped to help clients make real progress with individual fitness goals. It caters to clients at all levels from top sports performers to those new to a regular fitness regime.

feeds.title: AFFF Blog
feeds.description: The Australian Functional Fitness Federation (AFFF) is the national governing body for competitive functional fitness in Australia. The mission of the Australian Functional Fitness Federation is to promote and grow competitive functional fitness worldwide. AFFF is responsible for creating rules, standards, and guidelines for governing competitive functional fitness in Australia, as well as creating competitive opportunities for athletes of all ages and ability levels.

feeds.title: Functional Fitness Guru Blog
feeds.description: As we age, our bodies, minds, and metabolism change so to stay vibrant and pain-free our workouts, diet, and lifestyle must change too. Discover how to exercise and eat to alleviate back pain, lose weight, and get back to living. Find the latest exercising tips, recipes, and health news in the blogs.
